exact_statement: For every a>=1,b>=0,r>=1 let g=1-2A_a on a+b uniform bits and F=g+2A_r D_(a+b). Supply a normalized finite-cost source reference with c_raw<=C0 I(g), C0>=0; empty-calibrate and construct exactly the A097 complete floor Q. For every finite adaptive tree querying only active source bits, at each query with a_current>=2 reset the on-cell child to the A097 floor built from the marginal then empty-calibrated current source reference, retaining the actual conditional control kernel; on the last active query reset its on-cell child to the explicit point spectrum of -1+2A_(b+r). Every complementary child keeps its complete inherited marginal reference unchanged. The expected sum of all executed erasures plus all complete terminal cross entropies is at most c_cal+10e(a+b+r)<=(2C0+10)I(F), e=2^(1-a-b-r). At every a_current>=2 query the virtual source envelope releases at least e_current; the complementary signed reference excess is <18e_current. No original quota is renewed, and every previous debit and complementary terminal is retained. Arbitrary no-reset continuation below a stopping leaf remains paid. An untouched independent terminal of prescribed cost c_h retains its exact additive c_h. Structural source R=P_g permits C0=4 and initial rate18. This is not arbitrary-source reference construction, arbitrary incoming-profile reset, or a universal FEI theorem.
